review.brief:
Review RM38-gateway-read-dashboard-from-metrics (tier 2 of RM38, MAG-12) against its own design.md and the roadmap decisions D1-D9. Read the DIFF (commits 497f21b, 2e15c60, 1201133), not the whole module.
Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance - internal/gateway touches internal/analytics and internal/telemetry only through their public ports, no db package import, no cross-module DB read; (2) all four LatestSnapshotsByAccount call sites really moved to analytics.Reader.LatestMetricsByAccount, and h.telemetryReader is correctly RETAINED for history.go's SnapshotsByVehicleBetween; (3) every VehicleStatus pointer field is nil-checked per design.md's table, with no fabricated default and no unchecked dereference anywhere; (4) D5's badge matrix is implemented exactly - locked=success, unlocked=error, nil hidden; sentry on=warning, off=ghost, nil hidden - and D9's nil-CapturedAt rule holds (no date, no Stale badge, nav forced to Asleep with no last-seen label, never Connected); (5) dashSubtitle still keeps StatusLabel per D4 - only the Status stat tile was removed; (6) i18n - every user-facing string resolves through i18n.T with both ES and EN non-empty, and NO new catalogue keys were added (the six vehicles.* keys are reused); (7) htmx/Templ conventions per ai/htmx-conventions.md, semantic theme tokens not raw hex, and NO HTML comments in markup; (8) the docs actually track the change - internal/gateway/AGENTS.md and kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md; (9) TEST-CONTRACT CHECK, the important one: design.md authored the expected test values BEFORE implementation, so verify the wave-5 tests assert THOSE values rather than confirming whatever the code happens to do - a test reverse-engineered from the implementation is a finding; (10) Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy) - one port call per render, no N+1, no per-row query introduced; (11) anti-gaming - no acceptance criterion was weakened or deleted, no status self-approved.
Known and ACCEPTED, do not report as findings: make boundary-guard is still red because history.go legitimately keeps the telemetry import; gofmt -l flags dashboard_vm.go, which was already dirty on main before this change; fragments.Vehicle / vehiclesFor is effectively dead code (/ui/vehicles is unmounted) and was adapted rather than deleted, deliberately, because deleting it is out of this ticket's scope.
Signal provenance: go build, go vet, gofmt and the i18n/ui/tz/money guards were ASSISTANT-run and are green. 'go test ./internal/gateway/...' was USER-run and the user reported it passing. You must NOT run the test suite yourself - judge test quality by reading the tests.

verified: All four LatestSnapshotsByAccount call sites (dashboardFor/mapDashboardSnapshot, vehiclesFor/mapVehicles, navHeaderFor, buildChargesPage) repointed to analytics.Reader.LatestMetricsByAccount, matching design.md D2/D3/D8/D9 verbatim.

h.telemetryReader / Deps.TelemetryReader correctly retained; grep confirms history.go/gateway.go/handlers.go are the only production files still importing internal/telemetry, and no production LatestSnapshotsByAccount call remains (only fakeReader/fakeHistoryReader interface implementations and comments).

Every one of the 8 newly-pointer VehicleStatus fields is nil-checked before dereference at every call site (mapDashboardSnapshot, mapVehicles, navHeaderFor, vehicles.templ); no unchecked dereference found by direct grep of every '*vs.'/'*s.'/'*v.' occurrence in the diff.
D5/D7 badge matrix implemented exactly: dashLockedBadge/dashSentryBadge in dashboard.go match design.md's pseudocode byte-for-byte (success/error/hidden, warning/ghost/hidden).

D9 nil-CapturedAt rule verified: mapDashboardSnapshot leaves LastUpdated/IsStale at zero value on nil CapturedAt (no template change needed, confirmed against dashboard.templ's existing guards); navHeaderFor has an explicit nil-CapturedAt branch forcing NavStatusAsleep with no LastSeenLabel, before the connectedAt call - never Connected.
D4 confirmed: dashSubtitle (dashboard.go) is unchanged and still reads d.StatusLabel; only the fourth ui.StatTile (KeyDashboardStatus) was deleted from dashboard.templ; grid is grid-cols-3.

i18n: make i18n-guard run clean ('no hardcoded user-facing text found'); grepped the diff for new catalog.go entries - none; all badge/label text resolves via i18n.T against pre-existing vehicles.* keys per D7.
No raw hex colors or HTML comments introduced in the changed .templ files (dashboard.templ, vehicles.templ) - checked via diff grep.

Docs: internal/gateway/AGENTS.md's AnalyticsReader/TelemetryReader bullets and kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md were updated exactly per design.md D11, including the metric_date-grain and nil-field gotchas added beyond the minimum ask.

TEST CONTRACT CHECK: TestMapDashboardSnapshot_FixtureFull/FixtureNil, the 9-cell badge matrix table test, and the 3 httptest badge-render cases all assert the exact literal/derived values design.md authored up front (Fixture RM38-G-Full/Nil, badge matrix table) - not values back-fitted from the implementation. Badge text assertions resolve through i18n.T(ctx, key) using the same keys design.md's D4 pseudocode names, which is legitimate (the catalogue, not the implementation under test, is the source of the literal).
Performance-Profile: confirmed via internal/analytics/db/query.sql that LatestMetricsByAccount is a single DISTINCT ON batched read per render at every one of the four sites; no N+1 introduced.

Anti-gaming: no spec/task criterion weakened; tasks.md 1.1-6.2 checkboxes match the actual diff; go build/go vet/gofmt -l/make i18n-guard/make boundary-guard independently re-run and match the leader's reported signals exactly (boundary-guard red only at gateway.go/handlers.go/history.go + warn at handlers_test.go/history_test.go, exactly the accepted state).
Boundaries: diff touches only internal/gateway/**, kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md, and this change's own openspec/ artifacts - no other module or file touched.

rounds.summary: Clean, precise implementation. All four call sites repointed exactly per design.md, nil-handling is exhaustive and correctly guarded everywhere (no unchecked pointer dereference found), the D5 badge matrix and D9 nil-CapturedAt rule are implemented byte-for-byte against design.md's pseudocode, no new i18n keys, no boundary violation beyond the accepted/pre-existing telemetry-for-history exception, and the wave-5 tests assert the Test Contract's pre-authored fixture values rather than values back-fitted from the implementation. Three minor findings (two stale Go doc-comments in handlers.go, one tasks.md/progress.json checkbox mismatch) are cosmetic/documentation-only, carry no functional, boundary, or test-integrity risk, and do not block archiving. Approved.
